'''Trollbane''' were a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

==Description==
A stony-skinned bipedal creature, trollbanes were native to the [[Ordan Spine Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. Formerly an apex predator, the non-intelligent [[Species/Legends|species]] was dominated by the [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] who crash-landed on the planet. Attacking farms and villages that were isolated in the mountains, the trollbanes kept to the caves of [[Crysifal Peak]]. The legendary heroes of Weik were often depicted as killing trollbanes at the start of their careers.<ref name="NoP" />
